data.name: Drunk Pedestrians: Prelude
data.detailed_description:
The Vellarius is more than just a ship. It is a moving collection of bad ideas held together by confidence.

In Drunk Pedestrians: Prelude, you enter the Carnival Deck, a dense cluster of flashing lights, unreliable machines, and inconsistent safety standards. What begins as a casual stop to play a few games quickly expands into something else.

You will meet former celebrities who should have retired, crew members who are clearly overwhelmed, machines that do not function as intended, and passengers who expect more than they deserve. Some of them will ask for help. Some of them will assume you already agreed.

Each mini-game carries more weight than it first appears: A broken system points to deeper issues. A lost item becomes a personal crisis. A simple conversation turns into a chain of events. Everything connects, even when it probably shouldn't.

  • Processor: Ryzen 5 2600X / Intel Equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 560 2GB / Nvidia Equivalent

Recommended:

  • Processor: Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB / Nvidia Equivalent
